name: campus-eventos
description: Backend de Campus Eventos: API REST y worker de notificaciones (NestJS + PostgreSQL + SQS)

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w worker
scripts.test: npm test -w shared && npm test -w api && npm test -w worker
scripts.dev:deps: docker compose up -d postgres elasticmq mock-externo
